question: In a hospitalized patient who is unable to feed orally for more than 6 days, in which of the following clinical situations do we necessarily use parenteral nutrition?

options.opa: Cardioembolic stroke with complete neurological dysphagia.
options.opb: Cachexia due to chronic empyema in an immunosuppressed patient.
options.opd: Advanced Alzheimer's disease with serious risk of bronchoaspiration.
